title: Mystical Extended Tier - botany comp
description: Adds support for BontanyPots and Mytstical Extended Tier
body:
This Mod don't add any **new items** or **new content** that will just adds support for BotanyPots and Mystical Extended Tier.

Mystical Extended Tier add 9 seeds in the game and 4 farmaland but it is not automatically compatible with BotanyPots, that is why we need this mod if you have these 2 mods in your modpack.

This mod need **Mystical agriculture**, **Mystical Extended Tier** and **BotanyPots**
